By Staff WriterAlternative investment manager Investcorp has closed its second North American private equity fund (NAPE Fund II) at $1.22 billion, surpassing its $1.1 billion target and attracting commitments from institutional investors across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia.The fund focuses on businesses in the professional and commercial services sectors with EBITDA of between $10 million and $50 million.Fund II has deployed capital into Guardian Fire Services, a fire protection services provider, and Berger Financial Group, a U.S. wealth management firm.(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Seban Scaria)Ahmad.mousa@lseg.com
